citations.long: You did not implement procedures to ensure that all equipment is cleaned that could reasonably be expected to adversely affect the identity, strength, quality, or purity of a PET drug, or give erroneous or invalid test results when improperly used or maintained.

citations.short: Orderly handling, prevention of mix-ups, prevention of contamination
citations.long: Your facilities are not adequate to ensure the prevention of contamination of equipment or product by substances, personnel, or environmental conditions that could reasonably be expected to have an adverse effect on product quality.
